claims_checked.claim: Many stations have a standing side and walking side on escalators.
claims_checked.note: Common urban pattern; not universal in all buildings.

claims_checked.claim: Tokyo-area custom often stands on the left; Osaka-area often stands on the right.
claims_checked.note: Widely reported regional difference; signage and campaigns vary; some stations discourage walking.

claims_checked.claim: Some operators ask passengers to stand on both sides for safety.
